items.title: Android bulletin pattern: exported or privileged component misuse
items.summary: A generalized Android Security Bulletin style item describing component exposure or privileged action execution where attacker-controlled intents may cross an app or platform trust boundary without sufficient permission or caller validation.

items.title: Android bulletin pattern: file or content URI exposure
items.summary: A generalized Android Security Bulletin style item describing unintended file access through content URI, file path handling, or insufficient path validation at a trust boundary.
